description: Record WHERE a check was actually carried out (PERFORMED_IN). Without it a check run on a simulation rig and the same check run in the field are indistinguishable, so a capability proven only against a model reads exactly like one proven against reality. Point it at an Environment whose `env_type` says what kind of place that is — `simulation` for a rig, a digital twin, a physics model.

environment_id.description:
The Environment it was carried out in. Its `env_type` is what says
whether that place was a simulation.

verification_id.description: The check that was carried out.

name: performed_in
